edition: LanguageTool6.6 direct CLI; fixed source and bundled defaults, not runtime attestation

findings.claim: Both createAll overloads stream/filter/map the supplied configs; an empty list produces no rules or connection constructor calls through these factories.
findings.condition: Selected fresh CLI with the previously observed absent --remoterules; not all transitive/native networking.

findings.claim: configure iterates relevant configs; instance/channel creation is inside that iteration. Empty configs create no instance through this path.
findings.condition: Fresh state for the selected CLI; does not clear or inspect instances preconfigured by other embedding code.

findings.claim: Bundled XML specifies one INFO ConsoleAppender, no file/network appender or include. This does not remove direct System.out/System.err text-bearing outputs.
findings.condition: Actual selected configuration/overrides were not runtime-inspected. CLI root classpath and external configuration/code may change behavior.

findings.claim: Existing global is returned; otherwise tries SDK autoconfigure, and uses OpenTelemetry.noop when none results. Autoconfigure requires SDK class and enabled property (default false).
findings.condition: Conditional source inference; not proof no external agent/global provider exists in every execution.

findings.locator: 139 local JAR ZIP-entry scans and CLI manifest
findings.claim: No SDK/exporter package entries or OTel service descriptors found in scanned JARs; manifest names API/context/semconv. core-tests logging resources exist in libs but core-tests is not in CLI manifest.
findings.condition: Package-entry scan is not whole-program audit, dynamic class-loading analysis, complete service audit or effective runtime exporter inspection.

limitations: 33 language-all/language-* manifest references are absent as JAR files in the extracted distribution; root ./ is present with unpacked language resources. Manifest list alone is not a complete runtime classpath attestation.
Fixed source versions and artifact evidence remain distinct; no reproducible-build equivalence.
No new Java execution, active exporter inspection, exception trigger, network capture or retention audit.
No zero-telemetry, no-transmission, no-training or zero-retention claim. Prior text-bearing JSON/error and caller-copy findings remain.
External configuration, JVM agents/options and already-set globals were not retrospectively verified for all prior runs.
decision: Reviewed two factory gates and narrowed bundled logging/telemetry defaults. Research hold remains; no production privacy attribute.
nextAction: Use consolidated evidence to assess a narrowly specified CLI use profile and remaining material retention/rights/workflow gaps. Do not extend into new owner traffic captures merely to accumulate negative events.

documentation.finding: Current official manual describes ConsoleAppender default target as System.out; supporting documentation, not independent runtime/version proof.
